name: lem-hcb1-column-action
source: imports validated registry lemma proofs/lem-hcb1-column-action — Uniform Ha column action: there are universal C_act < infinity and e_act > 0 such that every H-CB datum with e <= e_act, every n >= 1, Z in M_n tensor S_{P,R}, and X in M_{n,1} tensor S_{R,Q} satisfy q_P((Ha^Q_{P,R})_n(Z)X-Z dot X) <= C_act*e*||Z||*q_R(X).
